text:
harper: Heads-up: external pen-test intake for July. Need a compact onboarding checklist covering RBAC snapshot, key handling, audit export, and retest gating. Can we map owners quickly?
lin: I can own RBAC snapshots + diffs. Plan: run a pre-window snapshot and commit it to a private git repo (signed). Will output `rbac-before.csv` and a `rbac-commit-sha` in the evidence manifest.
toni: I'll take KMS/key controls and evidence bucket. Proposed pattern: no direct kms:Decrypt to assessor roles. Use a decrypt-handler service that only returns HMACs + audit blobs. Raw plaintext via sec-ops recorded session only.
sec-bot: [automated] Created ticket SEC-30177: "Pen-test onboarding -> RBAC/KMS/audit pattern" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-30177
infra-oncall: Infra tasks: create `pen-test-evidence-4932109999` bucket with SSE-KMS alias/pen-test-evidence, lifecycle 45d, object-lock disabled for packaging. Mirror CloudTrail + VPCFlow for the window. Presigned PUTs expire 6h.
harper: Minimal deliverables before we allow an assessor to begin: 1) RBAC before snapshot commit SHA, 2) KMS key policy snapshot, 3) cloudtrail-hash.txt in the bucket, 4) evidence manifest with sha256s and sanitization flags.
lin: I'll add rbacs: diff-before.csv and diff-after.csv to prove no privilege creep during the engagement. Script will generate both and the commit SHAs.
toni: Key policy pattern: allow kms:DescribeKey to assessor role; Deny kms:Decrypt unless RequestTag assessment=true AND call from decrypt-proxy role. Example snippet for key policy condition I'll attach to SEC-30177.
harper: Retest gating (draft): A) No open Criticals. B) All Highs either fixed OR documented compensating control + scheduled patch within 5 working days. C) Evidence manifest present and checksums verified. D) RBAC before+after and key policy snapshots present. If any fail -> delay retest by 48h and run a root-cause action.
sec-bot: [automated] SEC-30177 updated: assignees set to lin, toni, harper, infra-oncall; due date 2024-07-10
lin: quick IAM session policy example for assessor (session-level) I'm going to use:```json
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"], "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::pen-test-evidence-4932109999/*" }, { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:DescribeKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/alias/pen-test-proxy" } ] }
```
toni: For the decrypt-proxy: it will run in an HSM-backed subnet, only accept ephemeral tokens minted by SEC service, and emit audit entries: `request_id, caller, timestamp, sha256(plaintext)`. We'll store those entries in the evidence bucket. No plaintext in logs.
infra-oncall: Canary plan: 1) snapshot SGs + IAM policies, 2) apply assessor-only SGs + NACLs, 3) deploy proxy and test end-to-end with a synthetic artifact, 4) mirror CloudTrail -> s3://pen-test-evidence-4932109999/cloudtrail/. Rollback script will revoke assessor roles and isolate subnet.
harper: Evidence packaging example (for assessor uploads):```bash
# upload findings with SSE-KMS
aws s3 cp findings.json s3://pen-test-evidence-4932109999/findings.json --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/pen-test-evidence
sha256sum findings.json > findings.json.sha256
aws s3 cp findings.json.sha256 s3://pen-test-evidence-4932109999/metadata/
```
lin: We'll require manifest.csv columns: `filename,path,sha256,sanitized,submitter,commit_sha`. Also require `cloudtrail-hash-4932109999.sha256` in metadata.
toni: Operational guard: decrypt-proxy rate-limit to 3 calls/hour and alert sec-ops on threshold. If decrypt-proxy invoked unexpectedly, trigger escalation and snapshot proxy logs.
harper: Assigning owners in ticket: lin -> RBAC snapshots + diff scripts, toni -> KMS proxy + key policy, infra-oncall -> bucket + canary + rollback, harper -> assessor coordination + evidence acceptance. We'll reconvene 24h pre-window for final go/no-go.
lin: I'll post the RBAC script and a sample diff output to SEC-30177 after initial review.
toni: I'll open a PR for the proxy and include unit tests that assert no plaintext logging.
sec-bot: [automated] SEC-30177 comment: "pre-window check scheduled 24h before start" added to ticket.
harper: One more compliance note: absolutely no raw DB dumps or customer PII in uploads. Provide synthetic or redacted samples only. Any exception requires sec-ops approval and recorded session.
infra-oncall: ACK. We'll also rotate alias/pen-test-evidence after the window and revoke any temporary roles.
harper: thanks everyone. Posting this as the thread summary. We'll run a tabletop for the killswitch next week. :white_check_mark:
